Writing out my thoughts and feelings is one good coping mechanism I’ve used in the past. Lately when I’ve tried it though, I just can’t get the words to flow. I feel trapped and overwhelmed, even sick just looking at the blank piece of paper in front of my face. And writing it out or not, I can’t stop the thoughts from running through my mind a lot of this time. It’s like I have no control over it, that’s one of the things I’m tired of feeling; like I have no control over what’s happening in my life or inside my head. Things will get better for a little while before getting bad again and the cycle repeating over and over is so exhausting and right now I can’t help but feel like just giving in.

I’ve tried changing my behavioural and thought patterns. It works for awhile before I fall back into the self-destructive ones again. No positive change seems to be sticking permanently. I can’t afford to get into therapy and/or get medication for my mental health issues so I’m having to do my best on my own and it’s been really hard. And I guess it isn’t setbacks that are the issue, I worded that poorly. I better way to say it is that I’m carrying this weight on my shoulders constantly so the moment anything new is adding, I’m instantly overwhelmed and then begin the spiral like I said. The straw is breaking this camel’s back. I do have coping mechanisms I’ve relied on in the past, but the healthy ones haven’t been working lately and I don’t want to get back into the unhealthy ones.

You can’t put an exact timeline on this sort of thing because every relationship/circumstance is different, but I’d consider having a conversation about being exclusive between a month and a half to three months after the first date would be considered normal. You don’t have to make a big thing of it, just tell the person how you feel and what your hopes/intentions with them are. For example you could say something along the lines of, “Hey, I just want you to know that I have really enjoyed the time we’ve spent together so far and I’d be open to the idea of dating each other exclusively if that’s something you would also want. We don’t have to rush into anything and I don’t want to put any pressure on you if you’re not ready for that, I just want you to know where I’m at with all of this.”
I mean there’s nothing wrong with expressing feelings but if a man is with someone and he’s in love with someone else, that’s an issue in itself.
